theme_strategy: Light Theme Only (High Contrast Flat Design / Swiss Brutalist)

rules: NO default Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.
Strict typography hierarchy, never jump more than two tailwind size steps between heading and subheading.
NO full-screen gradients. NO shadow values. Only flat solid colors.
Never use pure transparent background on elements that overlap content (e.g., sticky headers).

visual_enhancers.flat_design_enforcement: Strict 'Flat Design Assoluto'. ALL box-shadow, drop-shadow, and blur utilities are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.
visual_enhancers.separation: Visual separation MUST rely entirely on 1px solid borders, stark color contrasts, typography weight, and padding/margin.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Keep it sharp. Use 'rounded-none' for pure brutalism or max 'rounded-sm' for subtle softening. No pill-shaped large components except specific CTAs.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlays ONLY on the public landing page hero section if needed, otherwise stick to clean flat blocks.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular (`rounded-none`), solid background. Hover state: invert colors or add thick 2px dark border. Focus: strong 2px offset ring.
components.cards: border border-slate-300 bg-white shadow-none. No rounded corners. Inner padding p-6 or p-8.
components.tables: Crisp borders (`border-collapse`, `border-slate-300`). Use `border-b` for rows. Dense paddings in backoffice.
components.badges: Solid fill with contrasting text, sharp corners (`rounded-none`), no shadows. Color code based on pratiche state machine.
components.forms: Inputs with flat borders, focus state is solid 2px outline of primary brand color. Step-by-step wizard uses explicit bordered segments.
components.map: Leaflet with GeoJSON. Hover states on regions should use fluid SVG fill transitions (color shift) without drop shadows or glow. Use sharp tooltips.
components.wizard: Clear segmented progress bar without any rounded corners. Bold typography for current step.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing for public pages (`p-12` to `p-24`). Dense structured layout for backoffice dashboards (`p-4` to `p-6`).
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Dense BENTO or strict analytical grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`). Use `border-r` and `border-b` on grid cells to create technical look.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align mostly. Only center hero text if structurally needed.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions on hover (border color change, background fill shift, text color change). ZERO shadow animations. ZERO blur animations.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. High contrast text on all colored badges/buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='submit-pratica-button'`).

media_and_libraries.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight, matches business software well).
media_and_libraries.charts: recharts (styled with sharp lines, flat colors, zero drop-shadows on tooltips).
media_and_libraries.animations: framer-motion (for layout shifts, entrance, state transitions).

image_urls.description: A billboard by the road, suitable for public space advertising (OSP) SaaS context.
Italian public square (Piazza), ideal for representing events and public space occupation.
Computer monitor displaying data and graphs, representing Superadmin and Comune workflow.

instructions_to_main_agent: TUTTA LA UI DEVE ESSERE IN ITALIANO. Labels, placeholder, table headers, form steps must be perfectly translated in Italian.
Apply absolute flat design. Use standard Tailwind border classes (`border`, `border-2`) and specific background colors. Never use `shadow-*` or `drop-shadow-*`.
Implement the Leaflet map of Italy for the public landing page with interactive GeoJSON. Hover events should trigger a fluid path fill transition.
Build the dashboard using Shadcn UI but STRIP OUT all rounded corners and shadows from the default components (e.g., adjust radius in `tailwind.config.js` to 0 or hardcode `rounded-none`).
For the Comune backoffice, implement the Pratiche state machine (BOZZA → INVIATA → IN_ISTRUTTORIA → INTEGRAZIONE_RICHIESTA → APPROVATA/RIFIUTATA) using the explicit colors defined in the palette.
Use mock SPID/CIE logic for the login entry points.
Integrate a clear multi-step Wizard for the Pratica creation with document upload placeholder, ending in a Checkout mock.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends. DO NOT use generic centered layouts or uniform styling. Prioritize high contrast and 1px sharp borders. Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, structural transitions) but WITHOUT blur/shadows. Subdued grain textures, custom cursors, clear selection states separate good from extraordinary. Ensure all placeholder images use the provided URLs.
